description: Angular component for a JSON input widget in the Thingsboard platform, handling data input, validation, and saving attributes or time series data.

classes.name: JsonInputWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for a JSON input widget, managing data input, validation, and persistence within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the widget, setting up configuration, data validation, and form building.

methods.name: initializeConfig
methods.description: Sets widget title and label based on settings and datasource.

methods.name: validateDatasources
methods.description: Checks if the datasource is valid and compatible with the widget mode.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Creates the reactive form with validation rules.

methods.name: updateWidgetData
methods.description: Updates the widget's displayed data based on incoming datasource data.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Triggers data update when new data arrives.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current JSON data as an attribute or time series, with success/error handling.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Resets the form to the original value, discarding unsaved changes.
